associated_detail: qcc:          '<module>'-dependent functionality will be disabled in the compiled module
root_cause: QoreAOT.cpp deliberately attempts to load every %try-module dependency and emits these messages when it is unavailable. The nine separate module RPMs require qore-devel/qore-rpm-macros, so making them prerequisites of the initial core build creates a bootstrap cycle. Core source modules retain their optional branches; the AOT loader uses source fallback after an optional module becomes available.
proposal: Retain the exact nine missing-optional-module build diagnostics, with their explanatory detail. Preserve source installation, normal AOT behavior, all dependency/installed functionality checks and visible warnings. Do not add optional extension RPMs as core bootstrap requirements.

stages: Absent optional module: exactly the expected compiler warning.
Absent runtime: compiled unavailable branch executes correctly without runtime diagnostic.
Install optional fixture: runtime source fallback enables functionality.
Recompile with fixture present: compiler warning disappears.
Present runtime: compiled available branch works without diagnostic.
paired_control.scope: Synthetic optional module exercises the unchanged emitter and loader; does not claim real extension behavior.
